description.en: Premium cotton crewneck tee featuring an original 'Grace' typography design. Comfortable everyday wear that carries a message of hope.
description.zh: 高品质纯棉圆领T恤，原创「Grace」字体设计。舒适的日常穿着，传递盼望的信息。

description.en: Classic black tee with a gold foil-inspired cross design. Subtle yet bold — perfect for any occasion.
description.zh: 经典黑色T恤，金色箔感十字架设计。低调而有力量——适合任何场合。

description.en: Cozy fleece-lined hoodie with 'Faith Over Fear' embroidered across the chest. Warmth for body and soul.
description.zh: 舒适加绒卫衣，胸前刺绣「Faith Over Fear」。温暖身体，也温暖灵魂。

description.en: Warm cream hoodie with a minimalist cross logo on the left chest. Understated elegance for daily devotion.
description.zh: 温暖米白卫衣，左胸简约十字标志。低调优雅，日常灵修最佳伴侣。

description.en: Navy tee featuring John 3:16 on the back in elegant serif type. Premium ringspun cotton that holds its shape.
description.zh: 深蓝色T恤，后背印有约翰福音3:16优雅衬线字体。优质精梳棉，不易变形。

description.en: Adjustable dad cap with a finely embroidered cross. The perfect finishing touch to any outfit.
description.zh: 可调节棒球帽，精致十字刺绣。为任何穿搭画龙点睛。
